description: Plinthed jet fighter surveyed as a 24/7 walk-up monument with step-free access. Recorded in OSM simply as "MiG-15"; Polish town monuments of this type are almost always WSK-built Lim-1 or Lim-2 airframes rather than Soviet MiG-15s so the Polish designation is carried in aliases. No serial
aliases: MiG15; Lim-1; Lim-2; Lim1; Lim2; Fagot
